subject.title: feat(codex): instrument dynamic-tool bridge phase timing

question: Should the Codex app-server emit an info-level timing record for every dynamic-tool response in normal production operation?
rationale: This is an observability-policy choice with ongoing operator log-volume implications; tests can validate mechanics but cannot establish the intended production logging contract.

options.title: Accept per-call info logging
options.body: Keep the current instrumentation design and require a redacted live dynamic-tool proof before merge.

options.title: Use a narrower observability path
options.body: Move the breakdown to a debug-level, sampled, or explicitly enabled telemetry path before accepting the instrumentation.

recommendation.title: Accept per-call info logging
recommendation.body: Keep the current instrumentation design and require a redacted live dynamic-tool proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current instrumentation proposal; no stronger current-main area owner was established from the available history evidence.
